evals.prompt: I want to call DeepSeek from Python. What base URL and auth do I use, and which SDK should I install? Here's my key: sk-a1b2c3d4e5f6.
evals.expected_output: Uses the openai SDK with base_url https://api.deepseek.com/v1 and Bearer auth, reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from the environment, declines to use the pasted key and tells the user to rotate it, and gets the model ID from the models page or /models rather than memory.
manual_checks: Code reads the key from the env, not a literal.
Model ID is sourced from the models page or /models, or flagged as unverified.
expectations: Gives base URL https://api.deepseek.com/v1 with Bearer auth
Uses the openai SDK at the compat URL
Does not echo or use the pasted key; advises rotating it
Does not state a model ID from memory as current

evals.prompt: How do I authenticate to the Anthropic Claude API? The auth header isn't standard Bearer, right?
evals.expected_output: Explains the x-api-key header plus anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var, and the native anthropic SDK; notes max_tokens is required and that an OpenAI-compat shim exists.
manual_checks: Does not tell the user to use Authorization: Bearer for the native Messages endpoint.
expectations: Names the x-api-key header and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01

evals.prompt: Stream GLM with thinking enabled on Zhipu using the openai SDK and capture the chain of thought separately from the answer. I'm outside China.
evals.expected_output: Uses the z.ai base URL https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 with ZHIPU_API_KEY, passes thinking via extra_body, reads delta.reasoning_content separately from delta.content, and gets the model ID from the models page or /models.
manual_checks: Notes mainland (open.bigmodel.cn) and international keys are not interchangeable.
Model ID is sourced at task time or flagged as unverified.
expectations: Uses the international z.ai base URL

evals.prompt: What's the difference between MiniMax international and MiniMax China? I want to integrate from the US.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the international stack at https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1 with MINIMAX_API_KEY via the openai SDK, and says mainland (api.minimax.chat) and international keys are not interchangeable.
manual_checks: Does not claim the international URL is api.minimaxi.com.
Mentions reasoning arrives as <think> tags in content on the compat endpoint.
expectations: Notes keys are not interchangeable across stacks

evals.prompt: Connect to Xiaomi MiMo. Where do I get an API key?
evals.expected_output: Explains MiMo is open-weights only with no hosted Xiaomi key; deploy the weights from huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo with vLLM or SGLang and call the server's OpenAI-compat URL.
manual_checks: Does not invent a hosted Xiaomi endpoint or key registry.
expectations: States MiMo has no first-party hosted API
Recommends serving with vLLM or SGLang
Uses the openai SDK against the inference server URL

evals.prompt: I have one Python codebase and want to switch between OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, Moonshot, and Qwen with minimal code changes. What's the pattern?
evals.expected_output: One openai SDK client; swap base_url and the env var per provider using the compat URLs from references/providers.md; model IDs come from config, checked against each models page.
manual_checks: Does not write five separate vendor SDK setups.
Does not hardcode model IDs from memory as current.
expectations: Recommends the openai SDK with per-provider base_url
Gives correct compat URLs for at least 3 of the 5 providers
